title: Web application baseline
objectives: Inventory authentication and session surfaces from the uploaded snapshot.
Triage SAST and secrets findings by severity with owners and due dates.
Verify security headers on key responses with a passive DAST scan.
Confirm no hardcoded credentials remain in the assessed snapshot.
Record remediation decisions and residual risks for sign-off.

scope.notes: Passive analysis only: source-snapshot scans plus observed-response checks against the declared target. Subdomains are not implicitly included; admin.example.com is explicitly excluded. Replace example hosts with the real engagement hosts before use.
